description: This PHP script handles saving or updating mail account configurations for users within a vtiger CRM module. It processes form data related to mail account settings, updates or inserts records into the database, and redirects to a mailbox view.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: Represents user-related operations within the vtiger CRM; used here for password encryption

methods.name: Users::changepassword
methods.description: Encrypts or transforms the user's server password for secure storage
